feat(changelog): add initial changelog for version 2.0.0
- Added new make commands: `make:idm:common:contact` and `make:idm:user:bundle`. - Removed old command for creating a bundle; use [IDMarinas Template Bundle](https://www.github.com/idmarinas/template-bundle) instead.
This commit introduces the changelog file with the release highlights and details on added features and breaking changes.

feat: add Content topic XML file with make commands and references
chore: remove empty .gitkeep files from factories and fixtures directories

fix(services): correct service identifier for user bundle files
- Updated the service identifier from 'idm_maker.make.user_bundle_files' to 'idm_maker.make.user_bundle.files' in config/services.php.

refactor(Kernel): comment out loading of factories and fixtures
- Commented out the loading of factories and fixtures in the test configuration to improve clarity and maintainability.

fix: comment out PHPUnit extension in configuration file
- Updated phpunit.xml.dist to comment out the DAMA\DoctrineTestBundle\PHPUnit\PHPUnitExtension extension for better compatibility.
chore(deps): updated dev dependencies in composer.json
fix(deps): update idmarinas/user-bundle version to ^2.0 in composer.json

feat: add bundles configuration file for Symfony application
- Introduced a new `bundles.php` file to manage the Symfony bundles used in the application. - Included necessary bundles such as Doctrine, Framework, and Security among others for the project setup.
refactor(Kernel): clean up commented code in configureRoutes method

refactor(bundles): remove unused Doctrine and Security bundles
- Removed DoctrineBundle and SecurityBundle from the bundles.php file. - Cleaned up the configuration for better maintainability.
delete(symfony): bump symfony 7.0 version

fix(workflow): ignore all tags in push events
- Updated the GitHub Actions workflow configuration to ignore all tags during push events. This change helps streamline the workflow by preventing unnecessary triggers from tag pushes.

feat(tests): add BundleInitializationTest for kernel initialization
- Implemented a new test case to verify the initialization of the Maker Bundle. - The test checks the presence of specific services in the container after booting the kernel.

refactor: update path handling in MakerUserBundle and MakerCommonContact
- Added Path::canonicalize to getTpl method in MakerUserBundle for better path resolution. - Updated getTpl method in MakerCommonContact to use Path::canonicalize for consistent path handling.

Updated the instance version from 2.0.0 to 2.0.1 in the Writerside/writerside.cfg file to ensure compatibility with the latest features.

- Updated the following methods: - `getResetPasswordRequestForm` - `getResetPasswordForm` - `getChangePasswordForm` - `getRegistrationForm`

fix: update version and fix templates compatibility in changelog

- Changed condition to check if request_password_repository is not empty before setting it to null. This improves the logic for handling the password reset configuration.

- Set 'idm_user_provider' as the provider for both 'admin' and 'main' firewalls. - Ensure 'admin' firewall comes before 'main' firewall in the config. - Removed redundant provider assignments in the firewall definitions.

- Adjusted formatting in the "Fixed" section to enhance readability. - Ensured consistent indentation for the updated file reference.

fix(security): update login paths to use 'idm_user_login_web'
Updated the login and check paths in the SecurityTrait to 'idm_user_login_web' for both admin and main user configurations. This change ensures consistency across the authentication process.

feat(UserBundle): add Doctrine YAML configuration for entity resolution
- Added a new method `tplConfigDoctrineYaml` to configure Doctrine ORM entity resolution for User, Premium, and Connections entities. - Updated the `doctrine.yaml` file with the new entity mappings based on the provided sources.
fix: update instance version to 2.0.5 in writerside.cfg
feat: add ArrayUtilsTrait for recursive array merging functionality

feat(security): refactor security config updates in SecurityTrait
- Simplified the updateSecurityConfig method by removing unnecessary code and directly merging security configurations. - Updated the method to use arrayMergeRecursive for merging data. - Integrated ArrayUtilsTrait for better array handling. - Renamed tplConfigDoctrineYaml to configDoctrineYaml for clarity. - Adjusted the logic for writing configuration files to use self::$generator for consistency.

fix: update Writerside configuration for version 2.0.6
- Updated instance version in writerside.cfg from 2.0.5 to 2.0.6 - Added changelog entry for version 2.0.6 detailing fixes to User Make Command

feat(ArrayUtilsTrait): add arrayMergeRecursive method with updated behavior
- Implemented a new method `arrayMergeRecursive` that behaves similarly to PHP's `array_merge_recursive`, but does not convert non-array values to arrays, updating their values instead.
This enhancement improves the utility of the trait for merging arrays.
